children: According to CNBC, President Donald Trump said Saturday that a positive outcome could emerge from the latest breach of an FBI computer system. He confirmed in a Fox News interview that a system used by law enforcement agencies to share criminal justice information had been breached. Two people familiar with the matter told MS NOW that hackers accessed the National Criminal Information Center (NCIC), which contains FBI fingerprint records and information on wanted persons, violent felons and missing persons. The database is restricted to law enforcement use but is not classified, and it was unclear what data had been extracted. Trump suggested the breach might reveal information about voter fraud or Russia-related matters.

title: Trump Sees Possible 'Positive Spin' From Latest FBI Database Hack
